meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以操控浏览器浏览网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图和提取数据，并在合适时自动使用浏览器，把结果反馈给你。
howto.when: 当任务需要浏览网页、阅读文章、操作网页应用，或浏览器有助于完成任务时触发，即使你没明确要求。

say.note: Claude 会打开网址并保存截图。

say.text: 在这个页面上点击“登录”按钮。
say.note: Claude 会通过快照定位并点击。

say.text: 抓取商品页面的标题和价格。
say.note: Claude 会提取页面文本和属性。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can control a browser to open pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and automatically use the browser when helpful, returning results to you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task involves browsing the web, reading articles, interacting with web apps, or whenever a browser would be useful, even without an explicit request.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude opens the URL and saves a screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the 'Login' button on this page.
say_en.note: Claude finds and clicks the button via snapshot.

say_en.text: Extract the title and price from the product page.
say_en.note: Claude reads text and attributes from the page.
